## Workload

Daniel Roche graded 733 sets during 488 rostered hours. This represents an average throughput of 1.5 sets per hour. The workload record provides a clear summary of the volume completed and the time allocated for grading. No issues with the recorded workload were identified in the review.

## Quality

A sample of 60 sets was read again to assess consistency and grading quality. The recorded agreement was 78.3 per cent. This result is noted for routine monitoring and does not require further action this quarter.
